rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; f1040s2 p. 1, line 8, "Attach Form 5329 if required. If not required, check here"; i5329 p. 1 (given), Who Must File: "you don’t have to file Form 5329. Instead, see the instructions for Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 8 ... for how to report the 10% additional tax directly on that line"; i1040gi p. 112, Line 8, Exception: "multiply the taxable amount of the distribution by 10% (0.10) and enter the result on line 8 ... Also check the box on line 8 to indicate that you don’t have to file Form 5329". The box goes with a 10% tax entered directly on line 8; with no line 8 amount there is nothing to mark, so the project's "line 8 > $0" condition is the source's. (i1040gi p. 112 was not among the pages given; i5329 p. 1 was.) Project stands.
